category_edits.rationale: Across all four category models, use 0.9 times the current state plus 0.1 times a causal exponential pool with an eight-interaction half-life. Normalize over observed prefix positions only. Preserve truncation, clipped positions, backbone, embeddings, scoring, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports HSTURec from train.py, so it automatically uses the same readout and unchanged checkpoint shapes; its final-position readout remains correct for left padding.

edits.find:
pooled_sum = states.cumsum(dim=1)
        pooled_mass = valid.to(states.dtype).cumsum(dim=1).unsqueeze(-1)
        pooled = pooled_sum / pooled_mass.clamp_min(1.0)
        readout = 0.8 * states + 0.2 * pooled
edits.replace:
observed_positions = valid.to(states.dtype).cumsum(dim=1)
        prefix_weights = torch.exp(observed_positions * (math.log(2.0) / 8.0))
        prefix_weights = prefix_weights * valid.to(states.dtype)
        pooled_sum = (states * prefix_weights.unsqueeze(-1)).cumsum(dim=1)
        pooled_mass = prefix_weights.cumsum(dim=1).unsqueeze(-1)
        pooled = pooled_sum / pooled_mass.clamp_min(1.0)
        readout = 0.9 * states + 0.1 * pooled

change_summary: Replace causal mean pooling with normalized causal exponential pooling using an eight-interaction half-life and a 0.9/0.1 readout mixture across all four HSTU category models. Enforce the required data-directory environment variable.
